results.name: Belstaff Waxed Jacket 3D Scan | High-Detail
results.description:
This highly detailed 3D scan of a classic Belstaff waxed jacket captures the authentic texture, structure, and craftsmanship of this iconic fashion piece. Created using professional scanning technology, the model preserves fine material details such as stitching, fabric folds, pockets, and surface wear.

Ideal for use in:

Fashion visualization
Virtual showrooms
AR/VR applications
Game development
Digital archiving of garments

The scan delivers accurate geometry and realistic surface textures, making it perfect for designers, developers, and creative professionals who require high-quality 3D assets.

Key Features:

Ultra-realistic fabric and material capture
High-resolution textures
Clean topology suitable for real-time or rendering
Authentic Belstaff jacket design with multiple pockets and details

This model demonstrates the power of professional 3D scanning for preserving fashion items in digital form.
